notes.content:

notes.title: 📅 RELEASE DATE - Time Flies is coming July 31st
notes.content: [h3]Hello! A bit since you have heard from us, but [b]Time Flies is coming July 31st! [/b][/h3][p][/p][previewyoutube="FzAwgAIXn28;full"][/previewyoutube][p][b] [/b][/p][p]Flies are pretty annoying, and we’ve been listening to one every day for the past four years of game development.  Please do your part and Wishlist the game now, I really need therapy. 👍[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you and see you on July 31st  [/p][p]-Michael Frei @ Playables[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42506697/f967ae9dd5562f3ad7a20795fa4010a9d0f5bf7d.gif"][/img][/p]
